title: Late-Funding Refunds: Days After a Settlement Agent's Own-Error Return (Closing and Funding)
content:
**Treatment.** The days after a settlement-agent return are treated as follows for a Closing and Funding late-funding refund:

| Condition | Treatment |
|---|---|
| the settlement agent returned a wire through its own error, and the wire that funded the loan went out later than the last day of the re-send allowance | the days from the return date through the last day of the re-send allowance are taken out, and the later days stay refunded |
| the settlement agent returned a wire through its own error, and the wire that funded the loan went out no later than the last day of the re-send allowance | every day from the return date up to the day before the disbursement date is taken out |
| any other case | no day after a return is taken out |

A late day that the treatment of the days after a settlement-agent return takes out is not refunded, and the refunded days are never fewer than zero. A day the treatment of funds that were out already takes out is not taken out again.

Business days for the re-send allowance are counted Monday through Friday, starting with the day after the return date, and with no allowance the last day of the allowance is the return date itself.

A return counts as the settlement agent's own error when it is a wire return marked as a settlement agent rejection and the returned wire's amount equals the amount of the wire that funded the loan (the outgoing wire sent on the disbursement date); a returned wire whose amount differs carried Larkspur's wrong amount, and its days are not taken out of a late-funding refund. The wire that funded the loan is the outgoing wire sent on the disbursement date.

## Worked cases (hypothetical dates; return on Thursday the 12th, re-send allowance of 2 business days)

The allowance counts Friday the 13th as business day 1 and Monday the 16th as business day 2, so its last day is Monday the 16th.

| Funding wire sent on | Days taken out | Days that stay refunded after the return |
|---|---|---|
| Wednesday the 18th (later than the 16th) | the 12th through the 16th: 5 days | the 17th |
| Monday the 16th (no later than the 16th) | the 12th through the 15th: 4 days | none |

With an allowance of zero, the last day of the allowance is the return date itself: a funding wire sent after the 12th has only the 12th taken out.
